```json
{
    "title": "Analyze upload and download speeds per AP every 10 minutes for BEA customer within a specific date range.",
    "logic": "The query filters data for a specific customer ('BEA') and a date range, then groups data by access point (AP) and timestamps in 10-minute intervals. It calculates maximum upload and download speeds, their differences over time, and final speeds in bits per second using bucket scripts.",
    "content": {
        "summary": "Analyzing upload and download speeds for wireless access points (APs) over time.",
        "metrics": [
            "max upload speed (SSIDTable.TxDataBytes)",
            "max download speed (SSIDTable.RxDataBytes)",
            "serial difference of upload speed",
            "serial difference of download speed",
            "final upload speed in bps",
            "final download speed in bps"
        ],
        "filters": [
            "customer.keyword = 'BEA'",
            "@timestamp between '2025-08-19T00:00:00+08:00' and '2025-08-26T23:59:59+08:00'"
        ],
        "groupings": [
            "WirelessTable.AP_Name.keyword",
            "@timestamp (10-minute intervals)"
        ],
        "time_granularity": ["10 minutes"],
        "methodology": [
            "serial_diff to calculate differences in speeds over time",
            "bucket_script to compute final speeds in bits per second"
        ]
    }
}
```
